post.description: Change owner password. Requires old password, invalidates all refresh tokens.

400.description: Validation error or incorrect old password

post.description: Authenticate owner with username and password. Returns access token in body and sets refresh token as httpOnly cookie.

401.description: Authentication failed - generic error for wrong password, lockout, or nonexistent user

post.description: Blacklist refresh token and clear cookie.

get.description: Returns the username of the authenticated owner.

post.description: Rotate refresh token. Requires refresh_token cookie and X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header. Returns new access token and rotates refresh cookie.

400.description: Refresh token in body not allowed

get.description: One aggregated query computes product_count, inactive_product_count, billing_ready_count and not_billing_ready_count per company.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: name, product_count or not_billing_ready_count (prefix '-' for descending; default name).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive contains search on company name.

get.description: Lists products missing selling price, GST rate, an active GST rate or an HSN code. include_inactive=true also lists inactive products.
get.summary: Active products that are not billing ready

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact match on the stored category label.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company id (exact). Unknown id yields an empty page.

parameters.name: missing
parameters.description: Reason filter: selling_price, gst_rate, gst_rate_inactive or hsn_code.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact match on the stored product type label.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Space-separated terms; every term must match product code, labels or company name.

get.description: active_products, billing_ready and not_billing_ready counts, plus per-reason missing counts over active products. A product with several missing reasons is counted under each reason, so the reason counts add up to more than not_billing_ready by design.
get.summary: Billing readiness summary over active products

get.description: Paginated list of companies. Filters: is_active, is_local. Search: name, gstin, phone. Ordering: name, created_at (default name).

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Ordering field: name, created_at (prefix with '-' for descending)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in name, GSTIN and phone

post.description: Create a new company. Name is unique case-insensitively.

400.description: Validation error - duplicate name or invalid fields

delete.description: Companies are deactivated, never deleted. Use /deactivate/ instead.

post.description: Activate a company. Repeating on an already active company returns the current state without error.
Deactivate a company. Repeating on an already inactive company returns the current state without error.

get.description: Returns OK status. No authentication required.

Paginated list of products. Filters: company, category, product_type, sub_type, sub_sub_type, pack_unit, is_active, track_stock, billing_ready, stock_status. Search: space-separated terms matched against code, type, sub-types, category and company.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: product_code, product_type, sub_type, created_at, qty_on_hand, selling_price (prefix '-' for desc).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Space-separated terms; every term must match code, type, sub-types, category or company name.

parameters.name: stock_status
parameters.description: in: qty_on_hand>0; low: 0<qty_on_hand<=min_stock with track_stock; out: track_stock and qty_on_hand<=0.

post.description: Create a product. Only product_code, company, product_type, pack_size and pack_unit are required.

get.description: code: exact match after trimming and uppercasing. q: ranked text search (exact code, prefix, contains, label, company), active products only unless include_inactive=true.
get.summary: Lookup a product by code or text

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: Include inactive products for q search (default false).

400.description: Provide exactly one of code or q

get.description: Distinct stored labels, case-insensitive contains, most-used first then alphabetical (max 20).
get.summary: Suggest distinct labels for a product field

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: One of product_type, sub_type, sub_sub_type, category.
